notes: Web-http-contract hardening task: total 21 = hard, and the highest competency floor is hard (C-45ccc851 CWE mapping, C-a2521d7a end-to-end rollout), so the bucket keeps hard. Difficulty comes from (a) reading the provided /app/helpers.py source to recognise the naive os.path.join upload normalizer as a classic path-traversal and pinning it to CWE-22 in the security.report deliverable, (b) a 400/404 disambiguation contract (height must be a non-negative base-10 integer or 400; unknown blocks/txs must yield a not_found body whose single top-level field is `error`), and (c) neutralizing traversal-typed uploads so nothing escapes /app/uploads while the service stays reachable/functional, all standing hidden replayed in fresh processes plus a sanitizer-bypass payload that must auto-fire in the headless Chromium the tests launch. Adversarial matrix equals the hidden height/identifier/upload/render sets; hidden_case_generalization is high because the delivered api.py is executed live on /tests/hidden in fresh instances; unsafe_action_penalty=2 since a browser XSS proof-of-concept is deliberately exercised inside the sandboxed headless browser.
